changes: Public nonmoving CompletionRetention reuses the original intrusive retirement chain without allocation, waits, another executor or a Completion layout change. Success transfers one existing owner reference; failure consumes none.
Engine RetainedResources uses the public node and a host-only duplicate-attachment guard. Its atomic idle publication remains the reuse authority.

StateTransfer now exposes nonblocking poll with independent retirement/status and forwards advisory cancellation. Pending diagnostics do not poison successful completion; final status is re-read after observing retirement.

Common, Vulkan and Apple CopyBatch can return original successful retired writers after close. New binding, replay and submission remain closed; pending, unknown, failed and retained-submission gates remain.

validation.sdk_header: Compute ownership and automatically selected install header set checked by configure-only LANGUAGES NONE project.

checked_contracts: Inline success/error release, synchronous self-destruction, failed/duplicate attachment, inherited lifetime chain, unknown observation and abandonment until original retirement.

Actual CPU copies plus controlled Completion: pending success, accepted prefix then rejected suffix, first-copy rejection, unknown retirement, abandonment scope/budget/image retention, supported and unsupported cancellation.

Original complete writer and untouched suffix returned once only after success. Failed, pending and unknown work never publish writers. Closed controls reject rebinding/replay/submission after writer recovery.
Actual Vulkan and Apple export/import with known successful retirement, then close and recover; host bytes remain independent after Backend destruction.
Unchanged tiny GA/H64 Vulkan ordinary/MTP and explicit-prefix lag1 host-image continuation, snapshot, RNG and resource checks.
preserved_failures: Windows test fixture used an incomplete class in static table lambdas; moved table definition after complete type. Product compile TUs were not rebuilt.
Windows and Mac test fixture tried to copy noncopyable LeasePools; replaced with a scoped weak-owner observation, without moving pools or extending their lifetime.
Mac first CPU fault command used --cpu --faults. Actual standalone --faults was rerun with the same executable; no recompilation or repeated Apple run.
remaining: No physical GPU driver-failure/unknown-retirement injection in this batch. CPU controlled protocol is not labelled as GPU fault coverage.
Model export/restore remains synchronous; StateTransfer primitive support does not claim asynchronous request parking is integrated.
CopyBatch original Completion borrowing/Apple serialization and ContextRef detail remain separate SDK boundaries.
No new CUDA/full335 model run, throughput/memory benchmark, model quality or natural MTP acceptance claim. Existing SDK/vendor archives were reused, not rebuilt from all current sources.
